facts.fact: The Ministry of Finance's 2025 appropriation summary for the Ministry of Local Government, Chieftaincy and Religious Affairs carries a programme line 01106 Births and Deaths Registration Services, with one sub-programme 01106000 Births and Deaths Data Management, of GHS 7,409,170: GHS 500,000 of government funds and GHS 6,909,170 of internally generated funds, both goods and services, and nothing from donors (the columns are read from the table's own totals); the line names no information system.
facts.system: Births and Deaths Data Management (budget sub-programme 01106000)

note: A budget table only: it names no information system and says nothing of how or where a record is made. The one fact is the registry's own budget line, not a line for a named system.
